source_refs.note: Exercise 14.2, Question 12: work done by a force of given magnitude and direction (book p.275). Answer 99 sqrt(26)/13 Nm agrees with the key (PDF 312).

blocks.prompt: 12. A force of magnitude 6 units acting parallel to \(4\underline{i} + 3\underline{j} - \underline{k}\) displace the point of application from \(A(2, -1, 3)\) to \(B(7, 3, 2)\). Find the work done.
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein force components mein nahi di gayi: sirf us ka size (6 units) aur simt (\(4\underline{i} + 3\underline{j} - \underline{k}\) ke parallel) di gayi hai.
Diya kya hai? Force ka magnitude, us ki simt, aur do points.
Find kya karna hai? Work done.
Plan: pehle \(\underline{F}\) banayein (magnitude x unit vector), phir \(\underline{AB}\), phir \(W = \underline{F}\cdot\underline{d}\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(|\underline{F}| = 6\), \(\underline{F}\) parallel hai \(\underline{u} = 4\underline{i} + 3\underline{j} - \underline{k}\) ke; point \(A(2, -1, 3)\) se \(B(7, 3, 2)\) tak.
Humein find karna hai: work done.
Tareeqa: Constant force ka work done \(W = \underline{F}\cdot\underline{d}\) hai (14.2.8). Work sirf force ke us hisse se hota hai jo harkat ki simt mein ho, yani \(|\underline{F}|\cos\theta\), aur use faasle se multiply karte hain: \(|\underline{F}|\cos\theta \times |\underline{d}| = \underline{F}\cdot\underline{d}\). Is liye work bas force aur displacement ka dot product hai. \(\underline{d}\) shuru wale point se aakhri point tak ka vector hai (head minus tail). Lekin pehle \(\underline{F}\) ko components mein lana hai: kisi simt mein 6 length ka vector = 6 x us simt ka unit vector.

\(\underline{u}\) ki simt ka unit vector
\[|\underline{u}| = \sqrt{16 + 9 + 1} = \sqrt{26}\]
\[\hat{u} = \dfrac{4\underline{i} + 3\underline{j} - \underline{k}}{\sqrt{26}}\]
Kyun: Kisi vector ko us ki apni length se divide karein to simt wohi rehti hai magar length 1 ho jati hai. Yeh unit vector sirf 'simt' batata hai.
Dhyan dein: \(4\underline{i} + 3\underline{j} - \underline{k}\) khud force nahi hai; us ki length \(\sqrt{26}\) hai, 6 nahi. Isay seedha force maan lena sab se aam ghalti hai.

Force banayein
\[\underline{F} = 6\,\hat{u} = \dfrac{6}{\sqrt{26}}(4\underline{i} + 3\underline{j} - \underline{k})\]
Kyun: Unit vector ko 6 se multiply kiya to length 6 ho gayi aur simt wohi rahi. Yehi force ka sahi vector hai.

Displacement
\[\underline{d} = (7 - 2)\underline{i} + (3 + 1)\underline{j} + (2 - 3)\underline{k}\]
\[= 5\underline{i} + 4\underline{j} - \underline{k}\]
Kyun: Displacement 'aakhri point minus pehla point' hota hai, component by component. Ulta minus karein to har sign ulat jayega aur work ka sign bhi ghalat aayega.
Dhyan dein: Minus ka minus plus: \(5 - (-3) = 8\).

Work done
\[W = \dfrac{6}{\sqrt{26}}\,(20 + 12 + 1)\]
\[= \dfrac{198}{\sqrt{26}} = \dfrac{198\sqrt{26}}{26}\]
\[= \dfrac{99\sqrt{26}}{13}\]
Kyun: Number \(\frac{6}{\sqrt{26}}\) bahar rakha aur sirf vectors ka dot product kiya: \(4 \times 5 = 20\), \(3 \times 4 = 12\), \((-1)(-1) = 1\), jama 33. \(6 \times 33 = 198\). Phir upar neeche \(\sqrt{26}\) se multiply kar ke root neeche se hataya, aur 198 aur 26 ko 2 se chhota kiya. Work ek scalar hai (sirf number, koi simt nahi), is liye jawab mein \(\underline{i}\), \(\underline{j}\), \(\underline{k}\) nahi aate. Force newton mein aur faasla metre mein ho to work ki unit Nm (joule) hoti hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{99\sqrt{26}}{13} \approx 38.8\]
\[|\underline{F}||\underline{d}| = 6\sqrt{42} \approx 38.9\]
Kyun: \(|\underline{d}| = \sqrt{25 + 16 + 1} = \sqrt{42}\). Work kabhi \(|\underline{F}||\underline{d}|\) se zyada nahi ho sakta; yahan bas zara sa kam hai, kyunke force aur displacement taqreeban ek hi simt mein hain (\(\cos\theta \approx 0.998\)). Answer key bhi \(\frac{99\sqrt{26}}{13}\) Nm deti hai.
